## Summary

- Developed a number of KR&R systems for comparison:
	- Datalog (Rust/Crepe).
	- SWI-Prolog.
	- Answer Set Programming.
- The objective is to see which is the best light-weight approach for the TFLCD framework.

## System Equations
### Availability & Selection

::: {.eqs}

$$\mathrm{device\_not\_selected}(d, r) \iff \lnot\,\text{selected}(d, r)$$

$$\text{online}(d) \iff \mathrm{last\_seen}(d) + 1 > C$$

$$\text{offline}(d) \iff \text{capable}(d, \text{train}) \land \lnot\,\text{online}(d)$$

$$\mathrm{recently\_selected}(d) \iff \mathrm{last\_selected\_rnd}(d) + 3 > C$$

$$\text{eligible}(d) \iff \text{capable}(d, \text{train}) \land B(d, C) > 20$$

$$\text{selectable}(d) \iff \text{eligible}(d) \land \text{trusted}(d) \land \lnot\,\mathrm{recently\_selected}(d)$$

:::

## System Equations
### Trust & Persistence

::: {.eqs}

$$\text{persistent}(d) \iff \exists r.\; M(d, r) > 35 \land M(d, r{-}1) > 35 \land M(d, r{-}2) > 35$$

$$\text{trusted}(d) \iff \mathrm{trust\_score}(d) > 50$$

:::

## System Equations
### Battery

::: {.eqs}

$$B(d, r) = \begin{cases} \mathrm{initial\_battery}(d) & r = 1 \\ B(d, r-1) - 1 & r > 1 \text{ and } \text{selected}(d, r-1) \\ B(d, r-1) & r > 1 \text{ and } \lnot\,\text{selected}(d, r-1) \end{cases}$$

:::
